'''Harmon Kizzlebrew''' was a beverage served at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]]. Tracer chemicals could be confused by the bubbling of Harmon Kizzlebrew. It went well with [[yazstrimskizzie]]s.<ref name="FC" />

{{Food-stub}}
